entries.name: AinuIM
entries.note: Ainu katakana composer (AinuComposer, source bifrost.inputmethod.Ainu.Katakana): romaji keys to katakana, small finals ㇰ ㇱ ㇲ ㇳ ㇴ ㇵ ㇷ ㇺ ㇻ, ト゚ and ㇷ゚ for tu and pu, y/w after a vowel as i/u, Latin passthrough, backspace per key. Host tests only; needs a native Ainu check of the small h final and the unassigned small kana (ㇶ ㇸ ㇹ ㇼ ㇽ ㇾ ㇿ), a Midget check, and wiring in kb_input.rs and the kb_layouts source list (the method is in input_methods SOURCES and the plugin engine list).

entries.name: Assistive Control
entries.note: Built 2026-10-17: Settings > Accessibility > Switch Scanning (a11y_switch_scan) turns on auto scanning: the reader's cursor steps through the menu bar, open menu and front window every 1.5 s, speaking and ringing each element, and Ctrl+Alt+Space presses the one it rests on (Ctrl+Alt+Right steps by hand). Not built: an on-screen assistive keyboard panel and switch hardware other than a key.
entries.ready_note: Switch Scanning steps the screen reader's cursor on a timer (Reader::scan_due, Shell::switch_scan_tick) and the existing activate chord presses the element; the checks run the scan timer, the setting's persistence, the scan model and the reader

entries.name: CharacterPalette
entries.note: Edit > Emoji & Symbols is the character viewer: emoji categories, Symbols, Text Symbols and the Kana palette in tabs and pages; a pick types into the Search field or copies. Built 2026-10-17: typing in the panel searches the text symbols by name and the kana by romaji (Escape clears, Return picks the first result). Not built: names for the emoji (so no emoji search), recent emoji, and the Unicode category tables.
entries.ready_note: the character viewer panel browses, searches and inserts emoji, symbols, text symbols and kana; the checks run its paging, tabs, search and hit tests
